# parseA1Notations

<link-summary>Reads a comma-separated list of A1 notations.</link-summary>

<web-summary>parseA1Notations() — Reads a comma-separated list of A1 notations. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>appsscript/sheet</code> · Since: 1.6.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function parseA1Notations(value: string, options: A1NotationParseOptions = {}): GridRange[];
```

Each entry is read exactly as `parseA1Notation` reads one, so a list may mix sheet-qualified and bare notations. Whitespace around the commas is ignored.

## Parameters

| Parameter                     | Type                     | Description                         |
| :---------------------------- | :----------------------- | :---------------------------------- |
| `value`                       | `string`                 | The input string to be parsed.      |
| `options` _(optional)_ `= {}` | `A1NotationParseOptions` | An object with options for parsing. |

## Returns

`GridRange[]` — one parsed range per entry.

## Examples

### Reading a list

```javascript
parseA1Notations("A1:B2, C3").length; // => 2
```
